query: SELECT held.id AS "id!", held.created_at AS "created_at!", NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(held.after_siblings_json) AS waited JOIN agent_sdk_tasks AS sibling ON sibling.id = waited.value WHERE sibling.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'cancelled')) AS "ready!: bool" FROM agent_sdk_tasks AS held WHERE held.status = 'pending' AND held.after_siblings_json IS NOT NULL AND (held.created_at, held.id) > (?1, ?2) AND held.thread_id NOT IN (SELECT thread_id FROM agent_sdk_threads WHERE status IN ('deleting', 'deleted')) ORDER BY held.created_at, held.id LIMIT ?3
